name: personal-agent-assistant
description: 面向 macOS 和 Windows 的个人工作助手

scripts.format: prettier --write src/desktop src/renderer src/shared tests/desktop tests/smoke scripts *.json *.ts *.mjs .github/workflows/ci.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src/desktop src/renderer src/shared tests/desktop tests/smoke scripts *.json *.ts *.mjs .github/workflows/ci.yml
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:python
scripts.test:smoke:quick: npm run build && playwright test tests/smoke/app.spec.ts tests/smoke/summary.spec.ts
scripts.test:smoke:asr: npm run build && playwright test tests/smoke/transcription.spec.ts
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run build:core && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --publish never
scripts.package:dir: npm run build && npm run build:core && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --dir --publish never
